task: An airline's flight feed has to ship only complete rows, and a failed step must not loop forever. Using three flights, build a pipeline that validates the rows, works out each delay, checkpoints the last flight kept, retries a step a limited number of times, and writes what shipped.

produce.name: pipe.py
produce.about: Validation, delays, the checkpoint, bounded retries, metrics and the ship file.

produce.name: main.py
produce.about: Runs each step on the flight file and prints its result.

produce.name: checkpoint.txt
produce.about: The id of the last flight kept.

produce.name: ship.txt
produce.about: How many flights were kept and how many were rejected.

steps.P10.m1: Keep flights with a known status and recorded minutes.
steps.P10.m2: Turn each kept flight into its delay in minutes.
steps.P10.m3: Save the last kept flight to a checkpoint file.
steps.P10.m4: Retry a step, stopping at three attempts or a smaller limit.
steps.P10.m5: Count the kept and rejected flights.
steps.P10.m6: Write the kept and rejected counts to the ship file.

problems: One flight has no minutes, so it can't ship even though its status is ok.
One on-time flight still has 40 minutes recorded, so its delay must be 0, not 40.
Minutes are stored as text, so a late flight's delay has to become a number.
